caption:
New WordPress site not showing on Google? Check this one box. 🔍

Settings > Reading > make sure "Discourage search engines from indexing this site" is UNchecked, then Save Changes.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#wordpress #wordpresstips #seo #website #webdesign #googlesearch #smallbusiness #wpadmin #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Is one checkbox hiding your site from Google?
scenes.say: Is one checkbox hiding your site from Google? Check it in twenty seconds.

scenes.myth: My site is live, so Google will find it.
scenes.fact: WordPress can ask search engines to stay away.
scenes.say: Myth. My site is live, so Google will find it. Fact. WordPress has a setting that asks search engines to stay away.

scenes.title: Check the setting
scenes.say: Three steps. In your dashboard, open Settings, then Reading. Find the search engine visibility box. Make sure it is unchecked.

scenes.title: Discourage search engines
scenes.body: If this is ticked, tick it off and click Save Changes.
scenes.say: The box says, discourage search engines from indexing this site. If it is ticked, untick it, then click Save Changes.

right.title: When you launch
right.text: Unticked, so people can find you.

scenes.say: While you are building, ticked is fine. When you launch, untick it so people can find you.

scenes.sub: A new tech tip every day
scenes.say: Save this for launch day. Follow TechMendly for a new tech tip every day.
